joint_credence_rule: C-0009 starts at 0.35. Structural evidence adds at most 0.05 only if both predictive comparisons pass and the quota rival is independently distinguished. No physically evaluable association leaves 0.35 unchanged. Three independent physical agreements can give 0.65; an incompatible secure linked association gives 0.10, following C-0009. A failed minimum-size rule is infeasibility, not evidence against literal fish. No linguistic update.

predictions.statistic: Mean component log2 probability gain of the fixed-four construction over each of two frozen references: non-fish pooled number-V tablet values and their stroke-family-conditioned probabilities. Only complete clean Harappa tablets with W700, a strict coded stroke group first and a fish-family item before or after V enter. Equal whole-carrier prototype weight within each dependency component.
predictions.null: Symmetric component signs under no predictive advantage. The literal fixed-four model gives four probability 0.9, and every other value 1 through 24 probability 0.1/23. The strongest fixed-quota rival uses exactly those graphic probabilities and differs only in its external use prediction.
predictions.pass_rule: Both quantity-reference comparisons need at least eight untied dependency components, positive mean and every leave-one-component-out mean positive, and one-sided exact binomial p <= 0.025. The quota equality is recorded as an identification limit and cannot establish semantic support. Discovery has one eligible fish component, so an underpowered result is expected.

predictions.statistic: Number of independent registered tablet-container or tablet-allotment links whose externally measured unit, quantity and contents can be compared with the proposed reading.
predictions.null: Same site, square, layer or broad registration-series proximity supplies no physical content or quantity correspondence. A collection over several squares, depths or months is not a closed assemblage.
predictions.pass_rule: At least three independent direct physical associations, with unit definition and tolerance fixed before outcomes, agree. No unit calibration is currently available. Physical measurements found without a prior calibrated unit are retained as discovery inputs for a future shot and cannot pass here. Incompatible secure external sign identification is recorded under the prior kill condition.

discovery_status: One number-fish-V component. Appended signs have only fish as the observed item class; a within-band meaning-map calibration of literal contents is infeasible. The learned quantities, prototype handling and code are frozen before one confirmation read. The corpus is historically exposed, including a new source-series selection from already acquired rows.
